rewrites.comment: The app is a client-rendered SPA: only /index.html exists on disk, and expo-router resolves /catalog and the tab routes in the browser. Without this, opening or refreshing any address other than / returns 404. Vercel serves real files first, so /sw.js, /manifest.json and /_expo/... are unaffected.

headers.comment: A cached service worker outlives the deploy that replaced it, which is how people end up running last week's app.
Bundle filenames contain a content hash, so a new build is a new name and these can be cached hard.
